FAQ
A Few Things
Worth Knowing
  • Uniify helps independent artists, producers and songwriters turn their goals into a practical plan. Organise your releases, build useful habits and track your progress in one place.
  • The assessment looks at six areas of your career: releases, rights, identity, audience, money and goals. Your answers help identify what to focus on next.
  • Your assessment and goals shape your career roadmap. Add a release to get tasks for preparation, production, delivery, promotion and review. Suggested tasks adjust as you make progress or change your availability. Dates you set stay in place, and you can undo automatic schedule changes.
  • Your workspace saves automatically to your account. Sign in on another device to pick up where you left off. You can also export a copy from Settings & data.
  • Uniify helps you plan releases and manage your career. It does not distribute music or arrange industry placements. You can use your roadmap alongside your chosen distributor.
